hulls.name: Lancet
hulls.blurb: Raked needle nose, swept wings hooked forward at the tips, split tail. The original.

hulls.name: Anvil
hulls.blurb: Blunt chisel nose, boxy shoulders and two outboard engine pods hanging wide off the hull.

hulls.name: Manta
hulls.blurb: One broad blended wing with a notched trailing edge. Reads wide on the screen, flies the same.

hulls.name: Kestrel
hulls.blurb: Wings that sweep the wrong way, rooted at the tail and reaching for the nose.

hulls.name: Bulwark
hulls.blurb: A shield plate for a nose, welded seams down the hull and skids for engines.

hulls.name: Wraith
hulls.blurb: Faceted diamond planform with a chevron canopy. Nothing on it is a curve.

hulls.name: Hornet
hulls.blurb: A short central pod slung between two long engine booms with a porthole up front.

hulls.name: Comet
hulls.blurb: Round pressure pod on three raked fins. The friendliest silhouette in the hangar.
